source.quote: We expect our effective tax rate for the remainder of the year to be about 25%.

We're anticipating home closing gross margin to be around 18% for the year, with slightly higher SG&A than 2018, due to increased commissions expense and approximately $4 million of start-up costs to open our studio and showrooms in the remainder of our markets this year.

For the third quarter of 2019, we're projecting 2200 to 2400 closings for total home closing revenue of approximately $860 million to $935 million and a home closing gross margin percentage in the high 18% for the quarter.
